items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: do you know Lucas Pino? ... That young guy is hot on the scene. Beautiful player. But when Mike can’t be on a gig or something then Lucas or somebody else will.

ctx.x: I think it’s interesting that the brothers — I don’t know whose decision this was, but their fourth player is not a saxophone player. Because I think that would have made even this question of trying to sound like Brubeck, even more pressing because then it looks like a real, like we’re trying to re-create —

Right. I think so too. I don’t know, I know Mike Demicco has been playing with those guys, like he was in a band with Dan Brubeck for — he’s been part of the Brubeck thing for 35 years, right? So it was just an organic flow into keeping him. But he has told me, he gets intimidated by — he says, “Yeah man, I know people want to hear saxophone on ‘Take Five.’ They don’t want to hear the guitar.” “Don’t think about it.” Because that sound, even you know we’ve had sax players we’ve played with and do you know Lucas…
I do not. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
